one_line: Early Varman ruler of Kamarupa, linked to Nilachal Hills inscriptions and royal sacrifices in post-Gupta eastern India.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic but not bulky, with a calm, disciplined bearing
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown eastern Indian complexion, straight nose, slightly sharp jawline, high cheekbones, and large, focused anime-style eyes; thin arched brows and a small tilak of white with a central red line on the forehead; default expression is composed and dignified, with a hint of steely resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair parted in the middle and pulled back into a high, smooth topknot (kunḍala-style knot) at the back of the crown, wrapped with a narrow dark-red cloth band; sides neatly combed back, no loose strands over the face; he wears a simple gold circlet resting low on the forehead, plain except for a small central circular boss.
appearance.costume: He wears an early historic eastern Indian royal outfit: an off-white, ankle-length dhoti of fine cotton, tied around the waist in a broad wrap with the pleats brought to the front and secured, a distinct border of deep maroon and muted gold; above, a fitted, short-sleeved upper cloth (like a light angarakha/uttarīya hybrid) in pale saffron that reaches mid-thigh, with a cross-tie closure on the right and subtle woven stripes; over his left shoulder and across the torso runs a soft, maroon cotton sash (uttarīya) edged in gold, draped firmly and not slipping; his feet wear simple leather sandals with toe loop and ankle strap; jewellery is restrained—medium-sized round gold ear studs, a single medium-thick gold necklace with a small leaf-shaped pendant, two slim gold armlets on each upper arm with simple incised lines, and a plain gold bangle on each wrist; he wears a narrow cloth belt the same maroon as the sash, from which hangs a small, flat leather pouch at his right hip.
appearance.signature: A long, straight iron sword with a gently tapering blade (early kǔkri-less pattern), plain iron guard, and a dark-wood hilt wrapped in deep-brown leather, carried in a simple brown scabbard hanging from his left side on a plain leather baldric worn diagonally under the maroon sash, the scabbard tip capped with a small bronze fitting.

ref_desc: Mahendravarman (Surendravarman) is a mid-30s, medium-brown, oval-faced eastern Indian king with a high black topknot wrapped in a red band and a simple gold circlet, wearing an off-white ankle-length dhoti with maroon-gold border, pale saffron short-sleeved upper cloth, maroon sash, restrained gold jewellery, leather sandals, and carrying a plain iron sword in a brown scabbard on a diagonal baldric.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Mahendravarman (Surendravarman), an early 6th-century eastern Indian king: a mid-30s, athletic man with medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, high cheekbones, and large serious eyes with thin arched brows and a small white-and-red tilak on his forehead. His thick black hair is parted in the middle and pulled into a high, smooth topknot at the back of the crown, wrapped with a narrow dark-red cloth band, and he wears a simple gold circlet low on his forehead with a small central round boss. Dress him in an off-white ankle-length cotton dhoti with a distinct deep maroon and muted gold border, neatly wrapped and pleated in front; a pale saffron, fitted, short-sleeved upper garment that reaches mid-thigh and ties diagonally across the right side with subtle woven stripes; and a soft maroon sash edged in gold draped from his left shoulder across his torso and around his waist. Add simple leather sandals with toe loop and ankle strap, medium-sized round gold ear studs, a single medium-thick gold necklace with a small leaf-shaped pendant, two slim gold armlets on each upper arm, and a plain gold bangle on each wrist; a narrow maroon cloth belt holds a small flat leather pouch at his right hip. Give him a long, straight iron sword with a gently tapering blade, plain iron guard, and dark-wood hilt wrapped in dark-brown leather, carried in a simple brown scabbard with a small bronze tip on a diagonal leather baldric under the maroon sash, hanging at his left side. Show front, side, and back views, keeping the off-white, deep maroon, pale saffron, muted gold, and dark brown palette consistent and his composed, dignified expression steady in every view.
